limitations: Local fixtures describe future 2.11 instrumentation, not current product capability.
Old observers remove unlisted methods and deltas; they cannot prove native usage absence.
Native timing and usage are schema-only; receipt, semantics and durable storage remain unqualified.
Account aggregates cannot be allocated to stories; monetary cost and currency are unavailable.
Silent occurrence reuse without an observed discontinuity cannot universally be detected.
Cross-clock overlap comparisons are unknown; sums are distinct turn durations, not elapsed/human/CPU time.
